requested_outcome: Find and remove reproducible browser code errors across representative VII page families without changing approved behavior or design.
natural_destination: The exact local candidate rendered in a real browser on representative desktop and mobile routes.
authorization_boundary: Read-only production diagnosis and local source repair are allowed. No publication, production data write, DNS change, supplier mutation, or outbound message is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: A source edit or passing build cannot prove that browser errors disappeared.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require exact browser evidence for the fixed route and the complete affected template family.

lesson_bundle.reason: The observed error is produced by a shared gallery component used across worlds.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Audit representative vacation, event, spa and hourly detail pages on desktop and mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly asked for improvement without breaking function or appearance.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Keep gallery ordering, media identity, controls, labels and layout invariant; change only unstable React identity and other proven error boundaries.

lesson_bundle.reason: Several reported failures occur only in mobile gallery and slider states.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Exercise the affected component at 390px with gallery open, navigation, close and reload.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only one reported page is fixed while the same React error remains in other worlds.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Repair the shared gallery identity boundary and run a cross-world route matrix.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: No React duplicate-key or uncaught page error on the representative detail-page family in both viewports.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Console output is hidden or ignored instead of fixing the cause.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Capture exact pageerror, console error and failing network evidence before editing and retest after editing.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The diagnosis names a supported root cause and rejects competing hypotheses with reproducible evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The error disappears but gallery order, unit separation, arrows or labels regress.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve item ordering and selection semantics and run existing gallery integrity tests plus an explicit duplicate-source regression.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Existing gallery tests and the new duplicate-source identity test pass, with browser controls still usable.

affected_family: shared GalleryExperience mobile tour and viewer
homepage and world index templates for unrelated console errors

sources.label: VII accepted gallery identity and sequence

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the first representative detail page reproduces the console error and the smallest identity fix removes it.
checks: Reproduce duplicate-key error before the fix
Open and navigate the same gallery after the fix without a pageerror or console error
Confirm item count and first selected image remain unchanged

attack_questions: Does a duplicate supplier image still create a React key collision in another gallery scope?
Does mobile gallery open, move, close and reopen without an uncaught error?
Did the narrow fix alter gallery membership, ordering, labels, arrows or unrelated page behavior?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Real-browser local candidate results with captured console, pageerror and network status for representative routes.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests plus desktop/mobile route matrix across vacation, event, spa and hourly detail families and unrelated index pages.

effectiveness.baseline: A prior local browser run emitted repeated React duplicate-key errors in the shared GalleryExperience when supplier images were reused across gallery identities.
effectiveness.target: Zero reproducible React duplicate-key or uncaught page errors in the representative browser matrix, with no gallery behavior regression.
